basic_details.job_title: NHM Thiruvananthapuram Public Relations Officer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The District Health and Family Welfare Society Arogyakeralam, Thiruvananthapuram (National Health Mission) is filling 2 Public Relations Officer posts on contract in Thiruvananthapuram District at a consolidated Rs. 24,000/-. Applicants need MSW/MBA/MHA and two years' post-qualification experience. The online Google form on nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in must be submitted by 5.00 pm on 9 November 2026, and the printed documents must reach the DPM Office by 5.00 pm on 10 November 2026.

how_to_apply: Submit the online application through the Google form link on the nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in website on or before 09.11.2026, Monday, 5.00 pm. Only such applications will be considered.
Remit the application fee of Rs. 350/- as a demand draft in favour of "DHFWS-OTHERS TRIVANDRUM", payable at Thiruvananthapuram.
Take a print out of the duly filled application form (the online submitted Google form) and sign it.

Send or hand over the signed print out and the original DD of Rs.350/- to: The District Programme Manager, Arogyakeralam (NHM), DPM Office, W&C Hospital Compound Thycaud Thiruvananthapuram -14, by person or post.
Make sure the documents reach by 10.11.2026, Tuesday, 5.00 pm.
Write "Application for the post of ..........................." on the envelope, mentioning the post applied for.
Print out of the duly filled application form (online submitted Google form) with signature
Original DD of Rs.350/- in favour of "DHFWS-OTHERS TRIVANDRUM", payable at Thiruvananthapuram
Copies of documents supporting qualification and experience claims
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Candidates must be willing to work in any institution in Thiruvananthapuram District as decided by the Society. Canvassing in any form leads to automatic disqualification. An application can be rejected at any time during selection, without assigning any reason, if the details furnished are found incomplete, insufficient or misguiding. The Society reserves the right to cancel the candidate from the selection list at any stage of posting in the absence of relevant certificates or records. The Society reserves the right to cancel, alter or modify the notification without further notice. Candidates should check nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in regularly for updates, notices and announcements.

content_sections.heading: About the Society
content_sections.text: The notice is issued from the Office of the District Programme Manager, District Health and Family Welfare Society Arogyakeralam, W&C Compound, Thycaud, Trivandrum-14. National Health Mission Thiruvananthapuram District is inviting the applications for the post in Thiruvananthapuram District on contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is not to exceed 40 years as on 01.11.2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Applicants who already submitted applications under the earlier notification (NHM/TVM/368/2026-D9 dated 17.08.2026) will be considered under this notification and need not apply again. Claims about qualifications and experience must be supported by copies of the relevant documents, and originals may be asked for at the interview or certificate verification. Copies of appointment letters, salary certificates and pay slips are not accepted in place of a work experience certificate. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility details.

rows.qualification_required: MSW/MBA/MHA, and two year post qualification experience

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is Rs.24,000/- (consolidated). The selected candidate has to enter into a contract with the District Health and Family Welfare Society (Arogyakeralam) Thiruvananthapuram District and is governed by the NHM rules and regulations in force from time to time. The post is temporary during the period of operation of the Mission, with no claim to permanency of job or labour claims against the NHM, DHS or the Government.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NHM Thiruvananthapuram Public Relations Officer
content_sections.text: Submit the online application through the Google form link on the nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in website on or before 09.11.2026, Monday, 5.00 pm. Only such applications will be considered. Remit the application fee of Rs. 350/- as a demand draft in favour of "DHFWS-OTHERS TRIVANDRUM", payable at Thiruvananthapuram. Take a print out of the duly filled application form (the online submitted Google form) and sign it. Send or hand over the signed print out and the original DD of Rs.350/- to: The District Programme Manager, Arogyakeralam (NHM), DPM Office, W&C Hospital Compound Thycaud Thiruvananthapuram -14, by person or post. Make sure the documents reach by 10.11.2026, Tuesday, 5.00 pm. Write "Application for the post of ..........................." on the envelope, mentioning the post applied for. Documents named in the notice: Print out of the duly filled application form (online submitted Google form) with signature Original DD of Rs.350/- in favour of "DHFWS-OTHERS TRIVANDRUM", payable at Thiruvananthapuram Copies of documents supporting qualification and experience claims

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on qualification, experience and performance in the Written Test/ Interviews. The Society may prioritize the interview for different categories of posts on the basis of requirements, as the vacancies are for immediate requirement. No TA/DA will be paid for the interview. The notice gives no interview date. All communications from the Society will be sent to candidates by email.

rows.event: Last date for printed documents and original DD at the DPM Office

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will be summarily rejected. Candidates must be willing to work in any institution in Thiruvananthapuram District as decided by the Society. Canvassing in any form leads to automatic disqualification. An application can be rejected at any time during selection, without assigning any reason, if the details furnished are found incomplete, insufficient or misguiding. The Society reserves the right to cancel the candidate from the selection list at any stage of posting in the absence of relevant certificates or records. The Society reserves the right to cancel, alter or modify the notification without further notice. Candidates should check nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in regularly for updates, notices and announcements.

faq.question: Q1. How many Public Relations Officer posts are vacant under NHM Thiruvananthapuram?
faq.answer: The notice lists 2 vacancies for the post of Public Relations Officer in Thiruvananthapuram District.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 5.00 pm on 09.11.2026, Monday. The printed documents and original DD must reach the DPM Office by 5.00 pm on 10.11.2026, Tuesday.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Public Relations Officer?
faq.answer: The notice requires MSW/MBA/MHA and two year post qualification experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 40 years as on 01.11.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs.24,000/- (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee and how is it paid?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 350/-, paid as a demand draft in favour of "DHFWS-OTHERS TRIVANDRUM", payable at Thiruvananthapuram. The original DD is sent with the printed application.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Submit the Google form on nhmtvm.com or arogyakeralam.gov.in, then send or hand over the signed print out and the original DD to the DPM Office, Thycaud, Thiruvananthapuram.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on qualification, experience and performance in the Written Test/ Interviews.

faq.question: Q9. I applied under the earlier notification dated 17.08.2026. Do I need to apply again?
faq.answer: No. Applicants under the earlier notification (NHM/TVM/368/2026-D9 dated 17.08.2026) will be considered under this notification and need not apply again.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is on contract and temporary during the period of operation of the Mission, with no claim for permanency.
